title: Categories
subtitle: Group income/expenses to track them more easily
deleteConfirm: Delete this category? It can only be deleted if no transactions or budgets use it — you can restore it later from Trash.
seedDefaultsHint: Your family has no categories yet. Quickly create a set of common income/expense categories (and a "Cash" wallet if none exists) to start recording transactions.
ownerOnlyManage: Only the household owner can add, edit or delete categories.
nameInvalidChars: A category name may only contain letters, digits, spaces and - _ . , & ( ) / ' +
iconInvalidChars: The icon may only be letters, digits or emoji
